name: Carlin and the bound defenders

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest sequence · exact date unknown

summary: At Light’s Hope Chapel, Carlin remembers the people of the village and asks that the dead defenders be freed from Scourge service. The quest records a group of spirits bound in hostile forms; its objective count belongs to play mechanics, not a census of everyone who lived or died. The modest chapel in the open Plaguelands gives this act a place of witness, while the spirits’ exact appearance and number remain unknown.
